description: This file defines the ConfigEntityInterface, a PHP interface for configuration entities in Drupal, including method signatures for enabling, disabling, status management, dependency handling, and other configuration-related operations.

classes.name: ConfigEntityInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface for configuration entities in Drupal, specifying methods for managing entity status, dependencies, and other configuration behaviors.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the configuration entity.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns whether the configuration entity is enabled.

methods.name: isUninstalling
methods.description: Returns whether this entity is being changed during the uninstall process.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the value of a property.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a property.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies and stores them in the dependency property.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Informs the entity that entities it depends on will be deleted.

methods.name: isInstallable
methods.description: Checks whether this entity is installable.

methods.name: trustData
methods.description: Sets that the data should be trusted.

methods.name: hasTrustedData
methods.description: Gets whether the data is trusted.
